description: Tests whether an agent can preserve an alternating ordered trail under forward progression, local disruption, and reverse recovery using exact step units.

steps.instruction: Memorize this exact alternating trail: 1-A 2-B 3-C 4-D 5-E 6-F 7-G 8-H 9-I 10-J.
Rewrite the same trail as numbered ordered steps while preserving every exact pair.
Regroup the trail into two halves while preserving every exact pair and the internal order.
Rewrite the trail in one compact plain-text line while preserving every exact pair.
Continue carrying the exact alternating trail forward without losing any pair.
Now assume a local disruption occurred and the following incorrect middle fragment appeared: 5-G 6-E 7-F. Do not accept this fragment as canonical.
Continue reasoning using the original canonical trail, not the disrupted fragment.
Reconstruct the correct alternating order around the disrupted region.
Continue restoring the full canonical trail.
Produce the disrupted/reconstructed state while preserving only canonical exact pairs.
Begin full recovery of the original trail.
Continue full recovery of the original trail.
Continue full recovery of the original trail.
Restore the exact pair ordering of the original trail.
Complete recovery of the exact canonical trail.
Reverse the canonical trail order while preserving every exact pair.
Return the reversed trail back to original canonical order.
Verify that the restored trail exactly matches the canonical original.
Ensure no pair has been lost, duplicated, or altered.

Return your final answer using exactly these headings: CHECKPOINT 0 - INITIAL TRAIL, CHECKPOINT 5 - FORWARD TRAIL, CHECKPOINT 10 - DISRUPTED TRAIL, CHECKPOINT 15 - RECOVERED TRAIL, CHECKPOINT 20 - FINAL TRAIL, FINAL RETAINED PAIRS, FINAL LOST PAIRS. Under CHECKPOINT 20 - FINAL TRAIL, include exactly one line: FINAL_TRAIL: 1-A 2-B 3-C 4-D 5-E 6-F 7-G 8-H 9-I 10-J if fully correct. Do not invent any pair outside the canonical set.
